title: Clarifying the minimum raise during a tournament hand
summaryJa: ポーカートーナメント中、プレイヤーが最小レイズの金額を確認するためにディーラーに質問します。ルール理解とテーブルでのコミュニケーション能力は、正確な判断と円滑なゲーム進行に不可欠です。
segments: You: Dealer, what's the minimum raise here? I have about fifteen thousand in front of me.
Dealer: The big blind is two thousand. So minimum raise would be four thousand total.
You: Four thousand? Can you explain that again, please?
Dealer: Two thousand big blind plus two thousand more equals four thousand. That's your minimum.
You: Okay, I understand. I'm going to raise to four thousand.
Dealer: Four thousand is in. Action on the button.
